mostWorthwhile.text: Joining the head and spine to the trunk was most worthwhile: it showed how nerves and blood both reach muscles, connecting systems that had been built separately.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the eye and ears was clear but fairly predictable; each went straight into the head without much of a decision.

surprise.text: The repaired skin segment filled only a small forearm opening, rather than becoming the whole covering. That made its place in the larger body clearer.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt particularly arbitrary. The lymph network’s placement followed the chapter’s direction and its already established connection to a neck vein.

continue.text: I would probably continue if another chapter explored a new connection between systems. This final assembly was satisfying, though many of its placements were predictable.
